mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 660 and RSAFS < 400000, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) signals a potential for monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS > 130000) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime (UNRATE > 8.0% and GDPC1 growth < 0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals a deepening economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In recession regimes (UNRATE > 8.0% and GDPC1 growth < 0%), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 225) indicates a central bank that is keeping rates low despite inflation, which may lead to a loss of confidence in monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and CPIAUCSL > 225, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
